message: Additional DoS threat-model clarification from operator's follow-up (DO NOT rework or delay urgent source fix): DigitalOcean's always-on Droplet DDoS mitigation covers network L3/4 but explicitly not HTTP layer L7. Repo Program.fs invokes UseAuthorization BEFORE UseRateLimiter, so current /mcp authenticated-subject 240/10s fixed window does not protect unauthenticated HTTP floods. Keep scope: remove arbitrary authenticated concurrency and subject HTTP rate caps; DO NOT remove OAuth/scope/auth checks, request size/timeout/bounded process safety or unrelated /client-/exports policies. Before any PRODUCTION deployment, independently verify public Nginx/reverse-proxy defenses against anonymous request/connection floods (safe timeouts, header/body size, per-IP anomaly mitigation and/or edge WAF) rather than assuming DO L3/4 protects HTTP. Existing repo Nginx docs do not prove deployed config. Do not introduce speculative limiting of legitimate authenticated tool calls. Include a short explicit security/rollout note in review; no need to change current pinned spec yet. No live stress tests, merge or deployment.
